author: reek
body: Measured on the depot seed with a marker list allocated immediately after a three-element target -- arguments evaluate left to right, so the marker lands right behind it: index 3 and 4 answered the marker's capacity and length cells, and 5, 6 and 7 answered its three elements verbatim. Exit 0, no diagnostic.

author: reek
body: The negative-index half of this guard is fired by codex/test/list-oob-negative.codex. Neither can stand in for the other: one compares against zero and one against the length.
